arguments.cover_letter:
You need a SaaS dashboard for your healthcare business, and the projects below are the closest matches from my portfolio.

On Clinic appointment portal for a healthcare client I used React, Node.js, PostgreSQL and moved 70% of bookings online within two months.

On Loan application workflow for a fintech client I used React, Node.js, Authentication and cut application time from 25 to 8 minutes.

On Subscription billing dashboard for a SaaS client I used TypeScript, PostgreSQL and recovered 9% of failed payments automatically.

I have also worked with Data visualization on other client projects.

I can start this week. Would a 20 minute call suit you to confirm scope and milestones?
screening_answers: The closest match is Clinic appointment portal, where I moved 70% of bookings online within two months.
